Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

链条的末端。

山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实

The term “position compounding” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use several times leverage on a small amount of capital to ride a major trend, then compound it a few times
to multiply your capital dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What Position Compounding Does】Unrealized gains aren’t cashed out; instead, they’re treated as risk capital for a new position and used to keep opening trades,
It's essentially borrowing from the market to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
tens of points to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】Position compounding is essentially about “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the chance of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind the overnight-doubling posts you see are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

The Glamsterdam testnet upgrade window has arrived | Mainnet launch date still undecided | ETH nears $2,600—I’m waiting for confirmation

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to treat the testnet schedule as a mainnet benefit already realized. The Ethereum Foundation’s Glamsterdam announcement set the planned Sepolia activation time at October 6, 13:53:36 UTC, corresponding to epoch 353024; the core developers’ deployment schedule lists the same time. That window has passed, but I have yet to see an official postmortem independently confirming the outcome and stability, so I can’t say the upgrade was fully successful, much less that mainnet has upgraded. The Foundation has made clear that dates for Hoodi and mainnet have not yet been set, and ordinary ETH holders do not need to take action because of the Sepolia announcement.

Why is this worth watching? Glamsterdam is intended to introduce protocol-level proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists, and changes to cost accounting, with the aim of improving L1 throughput and block building. The testnet can check client compatibility and validator participation, but that is still a long way from “more economic activity on mainnet and increased demand for ETH.” Next, we’ll need to watch for the Hoodi schedule, an official mainnet announcement, app adoption, fees, and ETH value capture; a roadmap cannot be translated into short-term buying pressure. If the test reveals client divergence or the schedule is delayed, the risks would instead increase.

The market has not priced in the plan as a standalone reason for a rally. At the time of writing, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $2,612, down about 3.36% over 24 hours, with a high of around $2,725 and a low of around $2,592; the drop cannot be attributed to the upgrade. In Farside’s current table, U.S. spot ETH ETFs recorded total net outflows of about $201.9 million on October 6, mostly shown under ETHA; the figures may be updated, and they do not prove where each spot sell order came from. title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Position Sizing: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized profits is a surefire way to land on the liquidation list.
A frequent occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid position sizing.

【The rule】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirming again, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off the rails.
